name: nexusforge
description: NexusForge — intelligent cloud-native web engineering platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexusforge/api" "npm run dev -w @nexusforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexusforge/types && npm run build -w @nexusforge/api && npm run build -w @nexusforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexusforge/types && npm run typecheck -w @nexusforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexusforge/web
